article.title: Useful phrases for starting a meeting
article.description: Common professional openers: 'Shall we get started?', 'Let's dive right in.', 'Thanks everyone for making the time.', 'I'd like to run through today's agenda.' Register: professional but not overly formal — appropriate for most workplace meetings. Avoid overly casual openers like 'What's up guys' in a professional context.
article.content: Common professional openers: 'Shall we get started?', 'Let's dive right in.', 'Thanks everyone for making the time.', 'I'd like to run through today's agenda.' Register: professional but not overly formal — appropriate for most workplace meetings. Avoid overly casual openers like 'What's up guys' in a professional context.

generated.caption:
Ready to start your meetings like a pro? Choosing the right opener sets a professional tone.

Try "Shall we get started?" or "Let's dive right in." These are perfect for most workplace meetings – just avoid overly casual phrases like "What's up guys"! For example: "I'd like to run through today's agenda."

Save this for your next meeting! Follow @TheEnglishVault for daily lessons!
generated.script:
Meeting start karte time awkward lagta hai na? Sochne lag jaate ho 'Kya bolun?'

Dekho, casual 'What's up guys?' professional meetings ke liye bilkul galat hai. Iski jagah, use karo phrases like 'Shall we get started?' ya 'Let's dive right in.' Agar sab log time nikaal kar aaye hain, toh bolo 'Thanks everyone for making the time.' Aur agar agenda discuss karna hai, toh best hai 'I'd like to run through today's agenda.' Ye phrases professional hain but overly formal bhi nahi.

Toh next time meeting start karni ho, simple aur confident phrases use karo. Ab samajh aaya?

Comment mein batao aapka favourite opener kya hai aur aise hi English tips ke liye follow karo The English Vault!

slides.body: Starting a meeting professionally sets the right tone for discussion. Phrases like 'Shall we get started?', 'Let's dive right in,' or 'I'd like to run through today's agenda' are perfect for most workplaces. These openers strike a balance, being professional yet not overly formal, making everyone comfortable. Remember to avoid overly casual greetings such as 'What's up guys' to maintain a respectful and productive atmosphere.
